item.title: Torn Scroll, Untorn Robes: Jeremiah 35-38, Ecclesiastes 11, John 4, 1 Peter 1
item.description:
John 4:43-54, 1 Peter 1:10-16, Ecclesiastes 11, Jeremiah 35-38
Jehoiakim cut Jeremiah's scroll column by column and burned it, yet no one in the room tore his robe. We go deeper into the Rechabites, then follow Jeremiah through the burned scroll, the dungeon, and the muddy cistern, and ask whether he lied to Zedekiah's officials. Also Ecclesiastes 11 on sowing without knowing, the official who believed Jesus' word in John 4, and the prophets who served us in 1 Peter 1. Sources quoted: - John Calvin, Commentary on Jeremiah, Lecture 140, on Jeremiah 35:12-15 (https://ccel.org/ccel/calvin/calcom20/calcom20.vii.vi.html) - Jerome, Letter 58, to Paulinus (https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/3001058.htm) - Matthew Henry, Commentary on the Whole Bible, Jeremiah 36 (https://www.biblestudytools.com/commentaries/matthew-henry-complete/jeremiah/36.html) - John Gill, Exposition of the Old Testament, Jeremiah 36:30 (https://biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/jeremiah/36.htm) - C. H. Spurgeon, Zedekiah; or, The Man Who Cannot Say No, Sermon 2178 (March 30, 1890), on Jeremiah 38:5 (https://www.spurgeon.org/resource-library/sermons/zedekiah-or-the-man-who-cannot-say-no/) - Alistair Begg, Ropes and Rags (Part 1 of 2), Jeremiah 38:1-13, Truth For Life (https://www.truthforlife.org/broadcasts/2026/07/16/ropes-and-rags-part-1-of-2/) - John Calvin, Commentary on Jeremiah, on Jeremiah 38:25-26 (https://ccel.org/ccel/calvin/calcom20/calcom20.x.xxiv.html) - Gregory Thaumaturgus, A Metaphrase of the Book of Ecclesiastes, chapter 11 (https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0602.htm) - C. H. Spurgeon, Sowing in the Wind; Reaping under Clouds, Sermon 2264 (July 3, 1890), on Ecclesiastes 11:4 (https://www.spurgeon.org/resource-library/sermons/sowing-in-the-wind-reaping-under-clouds/) - John Chrysostom, Homilies on the Gospel of John, Homily 35 (https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/240135.htm) - R. C. Sproul, The Nobleman's Son, sermon on John 4:43-54 (August 11, 2002) (https://learn.ligonier.org/sermons/noblemans-son) - Augustine, Tractates on the Gospel of John, Tractate 16 (https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/1701016.htm) - John Calvin, Commentary on 1 Peter, 1:10-12 (https://ccel.org/ccel/calvin/comment3/comm_vol45/htm/iv.ii.iv.htm) - John Piper, Girding the Mind to Guard Your Hope, sermon on 1 Peter 1:13 (copyright Desiring God; text via Gospel Translations) (https://en.gospeltranslations.org/wiki/Girding_the_Mind_to_Guard_Your_Hope)
